title: Impact study of ONCOOK webinars on the quality of life of patients being treated for cancer
official: Impact study of a remote cooking and nutrition workshop program on the quality of life of patients being treated for cancer
summary: Not provided at time of registration

interventions.name:
The study calls for the participation in online cooking workshops (cookinars), at a rate of one workshop per month according to a pre-established schedule, with a commitment to participate in at least three of them over a 6-month period.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. French-speaking adults who report having cancer, regardless of their cancer status or the stage of the disease 
2. Not hospitalized in palliative care or in intermediate-care facilities (SMR) or long-term care facilities (EHPAD) 
3. Access to the Internet 
4. Normal oral intake, meaning the ability to eat a varied diet consisting of foods of different textures, providing energy and nutrition at any time of day, consumed orally, either independently or with assistance during meals.
Exclusion criteria:
1. No Internet connection 
2. Nasogastric tube feeding or parenteral nutrition  
3. Admitted to palliative care or to intermediate-care facilities (SMR) or long-term care facilities (EHPAD)
